title: The Knight's Secret Sign
summary: A young knight must write a sign and know the truth to solve a mystery in the old castle.

pages.text: A knight named Derek knew many things. He had the right mind for mysteries.
pages.scene: A brave knight in armor standing tall in a castle courtyard

pages.text: One night, Derek woke up. Something was wrong. He could feel it in his bones.
pages.scene: The knight sitting up in bed, alert and concerned, night sky visible through window

pages.text: He went to walk through the castle. The knight looked for clues everywhere.
pages.scene: Derek walking through dark stone hallways with a torch, examining walls and floors

pages.text: By the throne, Derek saw something odd. It was a small sign on the wall.
pages.scene: Derek pointing at mysterious markings on the castle wall near the throne

pages.text: The sign had strange marks. Derek tried to read it. "I must know what this means," he thought.
pages.scene: The knight squinting at cryptic symbols, scratching his head in thought

pages.text: Derek went to find the wise gnome who lived near the castle gates.
pages.scene: Derek walking toward a small cottage near tall castle gates at dawn

pages.text: The gnome was kind. "Can you know what these marks say?" asked Derek.
pages.scene: A small wise gnome opening his door to greet the knight

pages.text: The gnome looked at the marks. He began to wrap a cloth around them slowly.
pages.scene: The gnome carefully examining and handling the mysterious marks

pages.text: "I know this sign!" said the gnome. "It was made by the knight who came before."
pages.scene: The gnome excitedly pointing at the marks, eyes bright with recognition

pages.text: The old knight had left the sign long ago. It told of treasure under the stone.
pages.scene: Flashback image of an ancient knight carving marks into stone wall

pages.text: Derek went back and dug beneath the throne. He had to right this wrong.
pages.scene: Derek digging carefully beneath the castle throne, stone dust flying

pages.text: He found a box. Inside was gold and a note written in the old knight's hand.
pages.scene: Derek opening an ancient wooden box filled with glowing gold coins and parchment

pages.text: The note said: "This gold is for those who seek truth and know what is right."
pages.scene: Derek reading the handwritten note by candlelight, moved by its message

pages.text: Derek used the gold to help his people. The knight had solved the castle's mystery.
pages.scene: Derek distributing gold and supplies to grateful townspeople outside the castle

pages.text: Now Derek knew: being right means seeking the truth. A good knight must always listen.
pages.scene: Derek standing proudly in the castle courtyard, the mysterious sign behind him illuminated

metadata.story_arc: Derek discovers a mysterious sign, seeks help from a gnome, and uncovers an ancient treasure left by a previous knight
metadata.conflict: Strange marks on castle wall that must be decoded to reveal castle's secret
metadata.resolution: Derek discovers the treasure and learns that seeking truth is what makes a good knight
